title: Supreme Court Ends Custodia Bank’s Fight for a Fed Master Account, Leaving the Fed Free to Deny Crypto Banks Access
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Supreme Court Ends Custodia Bank’s Fight for a Fed Master Account, Leaving the Fed Free to Deny Crypto Banks Access The Supreme Court denied Custodia Bank's petition in No. 26-62 on Monday, leaving in place a Tenth Circuit ruling that Federal Reserve Banks may reject even eligible applicants for master accounts. This post Supreme Court Ends Custodia Bank’s Fight for a Fed Master Account, Leaving the Fed Free to Deny Crypto Banks Access first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
